description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Card', which serves as a reusable UI component for displaying content in a styled card format, typically used in dashboards. It accepts props such as title, subtitle, children, footer, and tone, and renders a styled section with optional header and footer sections.

methods.description: React functional component that renders a styled card UI with props for title, subtitle, children content, footer, and visual tone.
